code.layout: cats 0..d-1, ancillas d..2d-2; stabilizer j = X_j X_{j+1}; CX(ancilla j -> cat j) then (-> cat j+1)

noise_model.name: ocelot(nbar=2, lambda3, T1eff=57 us, Tc=2.8 us)

provenance.p_data[X]: DATA-DERIVED idle bit flip, Ocelot Fig. 16 static (Putterman et al., Nature 638, 927 (2025)); continuation A exp(-B nbar) beyond |alpha|^2 = 4
provenance.p_data[Z]: kappa_1,eff (nbar (1 + 2 n_th) + n_th) T_cycle with T1,eff = 57.0 us (default: Ocelot Fig. 30 mean, rep-code run) and n_th = 0.005 (prior)
provenance.f_mid: share of phase flips between a cat's two CX gates; 0.2 from the space-like/diagonal detector-pair split of the raw data (paper App. H) and the pulse timing
provenance.p_stab_x: our dressed-ladder ULE fault tables, variant lambda3 (paper Sec. 4, App. D)
provenance.p_meas: SPAM 0.015 (Ocelot App. F3) + our dispersive-phase syndrome error, fixed_gate (paper App. H); the measured growth with |alpha|^2 is only partly explained
provenance.p_herald: our f->e herald over the gates and the other layer's gate (paper App. H) + f->e during the readout of odd outcomes (readout + 80 ns / T1_ef, Ocelot Fig. 9d, App. F3)
provenance.p_data_meas: SPAM 0.015 of the g/e ancilla readout used for both the parity and the well (Z) readout (Ocelot App. F3; the Z readout fidelity vs |alpha|^2 of Fig. 19b is not digitized)
provenance.leak_anc: DATA-DERIVED: excess persistence of erasures between rounds, 0.2-0.6% (examples/zenodo_erasure_ocelot.py; paper App. H) -> p_leak 4e-4 per round with mean duration 2 rounds; heralded, outcome random; effect on the cats unknown (none assumed)
provenance.leak_data: none: two-photon stabilization returns the cats to the code space; excursions are converted into bit/phase flips (our conversion map, paper Sec. 4, App. D)

generator.sampler: stim.FlipSimulator + leakage in the incoherent approximation (dem/noise_models.py)

layout.heralds: round-major; per round the d-1 syndrome-erasure heralds of ancillas 0..d-2 (kind 1: ancilla found outside the qubit subspace, outcome random), then, if the model has them, the heralded bit flips of cats 0..d-1 (kind 2); the same bits are the herald detectors of detectors.b8, coordinates (x, round, kind); kind 0 = syndrome detectors
layout.leakage: rounds x (cats then ancillas) (round-major); 1 = leaked during that round

baseline_decoding.decoder: X basis: PyMatching 2 on the circuit DEM (leakage not in the DEM), correlated matching with the heralds; Z basis: none (no Z stabilizers), heralded cat bit flips undone
baseline_decoding.note: Z basis: the failure is the odd-parity probability of all cats, including the initial and final well readout
